name: Kinetic Copper Chandelier
promptTemplate: A kinetic sculpture of copper droplets suspended in {{formation}} formation with {{metal}} luster, wave depth {{wave_depth}}, viewed from {{camera_tilt}} perspective with droplet scale {{droplet_scale}} and wire visibility {{wire_glow}}.

ui.title: COPPER KINETIC
ui.tagline: A thousand polished metal beads rippling overhead

formation.hint: Morphs the kinetic droplet field into sculptural forms

metal.hint: Swaps luster and specular hue on every bead

wave_depth.hint: Exaggerates vertical stroke and wave amplitude

wire_glow.hint: Shows or hides the suspension lines reaching to the ceiling

listing.blurb: A thousand polished metallic droplets rise and fall on suspension wires to sculpt fluid waves, flight wings, and vortexes overhead.
listing.prompt: A kinetic sculpture of a thousand polished copper droplets hanging on invisible wires in a grid, rising and falling together so the whole field forms waves, a plane taking off, a spiral and a sphere, each droplet catching one highlight, seen in slow perspective from below. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
